pattern_explanation: These words look alike across the two languages but do not share a meaning. The similar form comes from different roots, so learners can be misled into guessing the wrong English word.
false_friend_warning: Beware of the Ukrainian word 'mahazyn', which looks like the English word 'magazine' but means 'shop'. A magazine is a printed periodical. Also, 'zamok' means 'castle' in the landmark sense but can also mean 'lock', which is a different object.
